profile.headline: Principal Software Developer | Root Cause Analysis |
profile.summary:
Principal Software Developer and technical leader with extensive experience supporting complex software platforms, infrastructure, and reporting systems. Known for bringing clarity to high-pressure situations through disciplined incident management, structured problem management, and root cause analysis.



Experienced in leading escalations, identifying systemic issues early, and helping teams move from reactive fixes to long-term solutions. Skilled at working across development teams, operations, vendors, and business stakeholders to stabilize critical systems and drive practical technical improvements.

positions.title: Principal Software Developer
positions.description:
Drive the implementation and customization of software applications which increase data sharing efficiency and collection, project evaluation, communication, project management and program outcomes. Modernize custom software applications with third-party vendors; negotiate purchasing, design, coding and software solution goals.

Selected Accomplishments: 
✦ Spearheaded the implementation of SDLC for the software development group (Azure DevOps/Team Foundation Server), boosting partnerships and client satisfaction rates.
✦ Completed NIST-800 37 and 53 and System Security Plans; created and maintained an application for the Federal government that passed Rapid 7 assessment and security scans; created an executive job search application using Bullhorn's REST API and a payment processing application that interfaces with Elavon.

positions.title: Software Development Supervisor
positions.description: Created monthly forecasts and annual budgets including in-depth explanations of results vs. forecast, risks/opportunity assessments and collaboration strategies. Oversaw technical integration in support of resolving complex issues to help deliver strategic projects, mitigate risks and identify strategic opportunities. Hired, directed and inspired a team of 11 Software Developers and guided the creation of 20+ software applications for job licensing, certification and training.
positions.insights: Process Improvement, Business Process Improvement and +14 skills

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description: Developed project roadmaps for 29+ MLS regions; implemented market data research and pipelined solutions for ongoing concerns and risks associated with technology and applications. Catapulted staff performance by focusing on internal production reviews, third-party relationships and change management adherence.
positions.insights: Process Improvement, Business Process Improvement and +15 skills

positions.title: Software Developer/Development Lead
positions.description: Supported functional and technical discussions with stakeholders to ensure products met market and customer needs. Developed a strategic approach for business intelligence initiatives, including developing estimates and timelines for business analyst deliverables.
positions.insights: Agile Methodologies, Personal Development and +12 skills
